video_title: Mike Conley's First Media Day As A Celtic ☘️

quotes.speaker: Mike Conley
quotes.text: There was a bunch of reasons, but ultimately I, you know, the culture, the atmosphere. There's a level of expectation here that I, you know, wanted to get a piece of. You know, just the the pressure, just everything about it is who I wanted to, you know, wanted to, you know, be as a player and compete alongside a guys who are built the same way. So I think it's it's going to be fun to to, you know, be a part of that atmosphere and the the culture here within within Boston.
quotes.news_angle: Mike Conley explains his decision to join the Boston Celtics.
quotes.social_post: Mike Conley says he joined the Boston Celtics because he wanted to be part of the team's culture and the high level of expectation.

quotes.speaker: Mike Conley
quotes.text: That fire is never ending, honestly. It's constant. It's in every every time I go to bed, everything like I focus on what I eat, I eat and like if I'm drinking enough water, like everything has that mindset of like what am I doing to better myself to get myself opportunity to to compete and and and, you know, I'm trying to, you know, figure that out here as far as what the what these guys went through, what they did, what differently than what I've I've done over my career and, you know, and try to tap into that and and, you know, force my urgency onto them a little bit, but, you know, also, you know, be a student of, you know, what I need to learn to be better as as the days go on each and every day across the journey.
quotes.pull_quote: That fire is never ending, honestly. It's constant.
quotes.news_angle: Mike Conley discusses his motivation to win his first NBA championship.
quotes.social_post: Mike Conley says his drive to win his first championship is constant, and he is looking to learn from his new teammates to help the team succeed.

quotes.speaker: Mike Conley
quotes.text: There's there's most days I wake up and I sit here and I and I am waiting on the day when I wake up and I'm like I can't move, I can't do this. I don't feel that. You know, I wake up and I'm still moving quick. I'm, you know, able to guard defensively, I still shoot, still do all the things. The role has changed a bunch, you know, as you get older, you start to get less on your plate, less on your plate, but I think that doesn't necessarily speak to what a person's still capable of doing. Um, so I'm kind of in that boat where like, yeah, I've, you know, it's years go on, I do less and less and less as far as, you know, numbers and all these other things, but the impact and what I can still bring and how I can still affect games, um, with my brain and with my body, I can still do it.
quotes.news_angle: Mike Conley addresses his evolving role and continued impact on the court.
quotes.social_post: Mike Conley acknowledges his role has changed as he has gotten older, but he remains confident in his ability to impact games with his brain and body.

quotes.speaker: Mike Conley
quotes.text: Joe's great. He honestly, he just keeps you engaged and on your toes at all times. Like, there's no way I'm going to practice, you know, not prepared. I come to practice, I'm just like, all right, what's what's about to happen? He's about to, you know, call me to do it.
quotes.pull_quote: Joe's great. He honestly, he just keeps you engaged and on your toes at all times.
quotes.news_angle: Mike Conley praises Joe Mazzulla's coaching style and intensity.
quotes.social_post: Mike Conley says Joe Mazzulla keeps players engaged and prepared at all times, making it impossible to go to practice without being ready.
